items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔表示赛车难以驾驶，被告知是前方的维斯塔潘造成的湍流空气以及轮胎性能不佳
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔表示赛车难以驾驶，原因是前方维斯塔潘造成的湍流空气和轮胎性能不佳
items.originalTitle: Leclerc reports the car is very difficult to drive, and is told that's the turbulent air from Verstappen ahead, as well as the medium being a worse ty...
items.summaryEn: Leclerc reports the car is very difficult to drive, and is told that's the turbulent air from Verstappen ahead, as well as the medium being a worse tyre #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 勒克莱尔报告称，赛车非常难以驾驶，并被告知这是由于前方维斯塔潘造成的湍流空气，以及轮胎性能不佳。#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Leclerc reports the car is very difficult to drive, and is told that's the turbulent air from Verstappen ahead, as well as the medium being a worse tyre #F1 #MexicoGP

items.titleZh: 安东内利成为唯一尚未停车的车手
items.summaryZh: 安东内利目前是唯一尚未停车的车手，尽管在诺里斯慢速进站后，他拥有一个舒适的差距，但维斯塔潘、勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿现在都在范围内，即使有虚拟安全车/安全车的情况。
items.originalTitle: Antonelli now the only driver yet to stop. He's got a comfortable gap to pit into whenever he does make it after Norris' slow stop, but Verstappen, Le...
items.summaryEn: Antonelli now the only driver yet to stop. He's got a comfortable gap to pit into whenever he does make it after Norris' slow stop, but Verstappen, Leclerc and Hamilton all within range now even if there's a VSC/SC #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 安东内利现在成为唯一尚未停车的车手。他在诺里斯慢速进站后，拥有一个舒适的差距，可以随时进站。不过，维斯塔潘、勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿现在都在范围内，即使有虚拟安全车/安全车的情况。#F1 #墨西哥站
detailEn: Antonelli now the only driver yet to stop. He's got a comfortable gap to pit into whenever he does make it after Norris' slow stop, but Verstappen, Leclerc and Hamilton all within range now even if there's a VSC/SC #F1 #MexicoGP
